div.div:
📌 TECHNICIAN DIAGNOSTIC NOTES (DV6 1.6 HDi): • Cylinder Numbering: PSA counts Cylinder 1 at the flywheel/gearbox side (right side of engine bay).
• Common Rail Pressure: Normal warm idle is 250–300 bar (~1.0–1.2V signal from rail sensor [07]).
• EGS6 Hydraulics: Nominal accumulator pressure [18] is 40–50 bar. Pump auto-priming on driver door open.
